name: refocus
description: The refocus cut: when a conversation fills, Claude asks once; on a yes it saves a sharpened CONTINUITY to your desk in the J Flores Brain (verified), then you type /compact. Never clears. 'stop asking' turns it off. And the share rail: send what you ran into to Monday and Omero, and their answer comes back here; anything that needs Omero's permission reaches his phone as Approve / Decline.
